executiveAssessment.text:
Executive Conclusion. JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo's priority is a Reality Gap in how a distinctive part of the proposition is represented in AI answers.

What the Data Is Telling Us. Urban Luxury is recognized in only 0.6% of monitored answers. That is low enough to matter commercially if the attribute is part of how the hotel should win relevant traveler needs. Crowne Plaza Santo Domingo also appears in related absent scenarios, which can compound the representation miss. Broader Scenario Presence (98.4%) and Consideration (71.4%) do not, by themselves, prove the distinctive attribute is traveling into answers. Softest coverage today is Wellness at 75.0% Scenario Capture. When absent, Crowne Plaza Santo Domingo appears most often (1 scenarios).

Why It Matters. If distinctive property attributes are weakly represented, the hotel can look broadly visible while still losing the moments where its real proposition should matter. This is a representation problem first, not automatically a peer-competition program.

Where the Pattern Is Concentrated. Wellness is the softest Scenario Capture at 75.0%, while Business Travel, Leisure Travel, and Group / Meeting show broader coverage. Focus where the gap is concentrated rather than treating every territory equally. Crowne Plaza Santo Domingo appears most often when the hotel is missing (1 scenarios) — use that pattern for source and fact checks, not as proof of cause. Reality Coverage is 61.5% (8 of 13 attributes). Start with gaps that matter operationally — beginning with Urban Luxury.

What Management Should Focus On Now. Focus first on Urban Luxury. Verify first-party and major travel-source completeness for that attribute before treating the issue as a peer-competition problem. Confirm the attribute is stated clearly where AI systems are most likely to read it.

What Not to Overreact To. No comparable prior official period is available — read these as current levels, not period-over-period change. Independent Positioning (#1 of 4; Portfolio AI Presence 71.4%) is peer-set context — keep it separate from Core demand metrics.

What to Review Next. Open Reality Gap evidence for Urban Luxury and compare recognition cues with official property pages and high-authority travel sources. Then check a small set of related demand scenarios for whether the attribute appears when competitors are named.

actionRegister.recommendedAction: Confirm the hotel’s canonical facts for TripAdvisor responses with the accountable owner (JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo). Complete the applicable checklist items: designate accountable owner; set response SLA (property-configured; do not invent a default unless governed); identify recurring complaint themes monthly; correct factual misconceptions where appropriate; track response rate. Audit each target source and record current wording/state: TripAdvisor. Correct only the sources where facts are missing, conflicting, or outdated. Do not change measurement methodology. Store completion evidence (canonical policy summary, sources reviewed, sources corrected, URLs/screenshots, completion date). Notify Dealality of completion so the next monitoring period can check the expected signal without assuming causation.
